title: feat(spec/contracts): verifyMcpAccessToken's verified result carries organizationId, the organization an OAuth consent bound
body:
Fixes #24165

Clause-②: yes

The `packages/spec` contract slice of ruling `6232069920` (letter A, the maintainer's 「同意」), recorded on #24137. #24137 remains open, and #24166 remains open: this PR declares the member only.

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/auth-service.ts`: `IAuthService.verifyMcpAccessToken`'s verified result, `{ userId: string; scopes: string[]; clientId?: string }`, gains `organizationId?: string`. Its TSDoc says what the member is:
  - the organization the user's OAuth consent bound (the consenting user's current organization at the moment of consent), read from the access token's `organization_id` claim;
  - absent for a token minted before consents bound an organization; absent means no organization, so only global grants apply;
  - a claim, not an authorization: the caller vets it on every request by the rule that vets a session's active organization (`vetOrganizationClaim`, `@objectstack/core`); once no current membership backs it, the principal resolves with no organization (global grants only: tenant reads come back empty, tenant writes are refused), never in another one; never the union of the user's organizations, never the browser session's currently selected organization; under ADR-0090 D10 it is the organization the delegator's grants are resolved in.
  - No tracker number in the new prose.
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/auth-service.test.ts`: one case in the interface's existing test home. Two typed reads (`string | undefined`) of `organizationId`, off a bound result and an unbound one, are the pin; `check:test-typecheck` compiles the file (zero ledger debt for it).
- `.changeset/24165-mcp-token-organization-id.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/auth-service.mdx` (`:41`-`:42`), patch round 1 at `890c170d5`: the interface block's `verifyMcpAccessToken` signature carries `organizationId?: string` as the contract spells the result. Its one-line comment says the optional `organizationId` is the organization the user's OAuth consent bound, absent for a token minted before consents bound an organization. The docs-drift check named five other pages (`kernel/contracts/index.mdx`, `kernel/index.mdx`, `kernel/services-checklist.mdx`, `kernel/services.mdx`, `permissions/authentication.mdx`). Each names `IAuthService` once and none restates the result shape, so they are unchanged. (Added by the dispatching seat from the dev's patch-round report `6236545086`.)
- Patch round 2 at `292bf5f32`, after contract review `6236564856` FAILed on one point: the `client_credentials` / machine-to-machine absence clause is removed from all four carriers (the TSDoc, the pin's comment, the changeset's **Absent** bullet and the docs page's comment). The one implementer refuses such a token before any result exists (`auth-manager.ts`, `sub` equal to `client_id` or `azp` answers `null`), so the clause described a result the surface never returns. The clause came from the card body's gloss, through the dispatch. Contract review `6237222227` PASSes on this head. (Added by the dispatching seat.)

Ruling items this slice carries, verbatim from `6232069920`: "The access token carries it as the claim **`organization_id`**." · "Every request re-checks membership through the existing session path. ⛔ Never the union of the user's organizations, never a widened global grant, never the browser session's current organization (B), never a D9-style pick (C2)." · "The token falls back to no organization, so only global grants apply: reads come back empty and tenant writes are refused loudly." · "The `packages/spec` contract type for the verified-token result. Spec seat, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`."

## Premise, measured before editing

- On `origin/main` `cb8756b00`, `auth-service.ts:297` read `verifyMcpAccessToken?(token: string)` with the three-member result and no `organizationId` (`grep -n verifyMcpAccessToken packages/spec/src` gave that one line; the positive control `clientId?: string` hits the same line).
- The one implementer, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` `verifyMcpAccessToken` (`:6786`), is not typed against the interface, and the runtime reader (`packages/runtime/src/security/resolve-execution-context.ts:159`) reaches it through `any`. The member is optional, so neither changes.

## Verification (all at `06210ccf8`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: exit 0; the tree stayed clean (`git status --porcelain` empty), so no generated artifact moved. The rebuilt `dist/contracts/index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts` carry the member (1 hit each); `index.js` and `index.mjs` carry 0, because an interface is erased, so no emitted JavaScript byte changed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". The `api-surface` shard does not move: it records export names, and no export was added.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: 692 files passed, 20975 tests passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0 (build program, scripts program, test layer).
- Downstream consumers of `@objectstack/spec` that hold `IAuthService` (dependency closures built with `turbo run build --filter='PKG^...' --concurrency=2`), each `typecheck` exit 0: `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection`.
- Reverse verification (one-off, not committed): a temporary `packages/mcp/src` file read `organizationId` as `string | undefined` and assigned `organizationId: 123` on an annotated result. `tsc --noEmit` gave exactly one error, `TS2322: Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'` on the second line. Against the old declaration the read would be TS2339 and the literal TS2353, so consumers read the rebuilt `.d.ts`. File deleted; tree clean.
- Ablation (one-off, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with an EXIT/INT/TERM restore): deleting the `organizationId?: string;` line made `check:test-typecheck` red with "src/contracts/auth-service.test.ts: 2 type error(s)". Restore proven: blob equals HEAD (`e2d1d8138861`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Derived gate families: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gave 84 commands at `06210ccf8`. All 84 ran with exit codes recorded. Four first exited 3 (prerequisites: a pinned fixture commit outside the shallow clone, and unbuilt dists). After fetching that commit and building, all four re-ran exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "84 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 84 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/runtime/src/security/resolve-execution-context.ts:154` says `verifyMcpAccessToken` is "implemented (auth-manager.ts) and undeclared". That was already false on `origin/main` (the contract declares the method) and stays false. It is runtime's file and the runtime slice's lane, so it is not edited here. Carrier: #24137's runtime slice, which edits that block.
- The implementer answers `null` where the contract's type says `undefined`. The contract's prose ("a falsy value") covers both, and nothing types the implementer against the interface, so it is dormant. Noted, not filed.
- `main` moved three commits after the base (`727091c82`). None touches this diff's files or any generated artifact this diff could move. CI runs on the merge ref.
